title: tecap: 3' terminal exon capture diagnostics for long-read scRNA-seq
description: tecap classifies long-read alignments by where their 3' end lands relative to the terminal exon, its UTR, and a polyA site atlas. It decomposes capture failures into nine mechanism buckets and measures reference base composition downstream of each read's site: it labels the site templated, non-templated or ambiguous from the adenines in the 20 nt downstream, and reports descriptive bands of the adenine share (30% to 50% A, 40% A or more, 60% A or more). Measured at the alignment end, the 30% to 50% and 60% bands split single-cell preps from bulk Iso-Seq; the biochemical driver of the split is uncharacterized.
